story_arceus_11_06000/2401_1001_100_10: I’ve been waiting for you, Hau!
story_arceus_11_06000/2401_1001_200_10:
You want to polish your skills to beat your
rival, right?
story_arceus_11_06000/2401_1001_300_10:
Yeah! I wanna meet Gladion and Silvally’s
feelings head-on!
story_arceus_11_06000/2401_1001_400_10:
I can’t let my guard down just because
they’re my friends!
story_arceus_11_06000/2401_1001_600_10:
You’ve sure got the right attitude!
Now I’m feeling fired up too!
story_arceus_11_06000/2401_1001_700_10:
If you’re so motivated, then I don’t have to
hold back!
story_arceus_11_06000/2401_1001_800_10:
We’ll take you on and have an ULTIMATE
champion time!
story_arceus_11_06000/2401_1001_900_10:
Let’s do this, Raichu! We’ll go full power and
hit ’em with all we got!
